europe_now.title: King Harald V of Norway dies at 89
europe_now.summary: Norway's King Harald V has passed away at the age of 89. His son has succeeded him to the throne as King Haakon VIII.

sources.headline: 🔴 Europe's oldest monarch, King Harald V of Norway dies at 89

europe_now.title: Former Bosnian Serb general Ratko Mladić dies at 84
europe_now.summary: Ratko Mladić, the former Bosnian Serb military leader convicted of genocide, has died at the age of 84. He was known for his role in the Srebrenica massacre during the Bosnian war.

sources.headline: The man behind Srebrenica: Ratko Mladic dies at 84
Allan Little: I met dangerously fanatical Mladić early in Bosnian war

top_stories.title: French presidential candidates hold first debate
top_stories.summary: Candidates for the French presidency have participated in their initial debate ahead of the upcoming election. The event featured clashes among the contenders as they presented their political platforms.

sources.headline: French presidential candidates clash at first debate before upcoming elections

top_stories.title: German far-right party leverages eastern nostalgia for election gains
top_stories.summary: A far-right political party in Germany is using nostalgia for the communist era in the eastern part of the country to boost its election prospects. This strategy is being employed to propel a surge in their political support.

sources.headline: Germany’s far right taps nostalgia for communist East to propel election surge

top_stories.title: US military reports critical Patriot missile shortage in Europe
top_stories.summary: The United States military is experiencing a severe shortage of Patriot missiles deployed in Europe. This deficit is described as beyond critical for regional defense capabilities.

sources.headline: US military faces ‘beyond critical’ shortage of Patriot missiles in Europe

top_stories.title: Kherson residents urged to evacuate amid Russian attacks
top_stories.summary: Authorities are urging residents of Kherson to leave the area as Russian military strikes threaten local power and heating infrastructure. The attacks are intensifying concerns for civilian safety as winter approaches.

sources.headline: Kherson residents urged to leave as Russian attacks threaten power and heating
